title: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Class Scheduling Software (2026)
description: Brazilian jiu jitsu class scheduling software compared: Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk, Spark, Zen Planner and RhinoFit on booking, calendars and prices.
h1: Brazilian jiu jitsu class scheduling software
keyword: brazilian jiu jitsu class scheduling software
body:
Brazilian jiu jitsu academies run overlapping gi and no-gi classes, kids and adults programs, and open mats that fill up fast. Class scheduling software lets students book (or cancel) from their phone, caps capacity, and feeds attendance into belt and stripe tracking. Here is what each vendor publishes about scheduling.

We checked each vendor's own public pricing and feature pages on November 3, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk,spark-membership,zen-planner,rhinofit}}

How each tool handles BJJ class scheduling

  • Kicksite: lists attendance tracking and class scheduling among core features; students register for classes and events in the Member Portal mobile web app (Kicksite FAQ). Pricing is by active students from $49/mo (0-25) to $199/mo (101+), with every feature on every tier (Kicksite pricing). Kicksite names Jiu-Jitsu on its belt tracking copy.
  • Martialytics: Bookings & Events with a calendar and capacity optimisation; create recurring classes or one-off events (seminars, gradings); students book via website widget, student app, or invitation only (Martialytics features). From $69/mo for 0-50 students; every feature on every plan (Martialytics pricing). Martialytics also publishes a BJJ gyms page.
  • Gymdesk: a class schedule members book and manage from their phone, plus a mobile app for booking (Gymdesk homepage). From $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments for up to 50 active members, or $100/mo with your own processor (Gymdesk pricing). Gymdesk started in martial arts and lists BJJ among supported gym types.
  • Spark Membership: class scheduling on one calendar next to billing and attendance; members book and pay in the free Spark Member App; Spark's BJJ page says it supports separate rosters and schedules for gi and no-gi programs (Spark BJJ gym software; gym management program). $199/mo after an 8-week free trial (Spark pricing).
  • Zen Planner: online class scheduling with waitlists, capacity limits and automatic reminders; members book online or from the app (Zen Planner membership management). Studio starts at $99/mo for 0-45 active members and scales by member count; Essentials (Studio + website) from $198/mo; Ultimate from $348/mo (Zen Planner active-member tiers).
  • RhinoFit: Class & Appointment Scheduling plus Check-In, Reserve, and Attend on every plan, including the $0 Start Up plan (20 or fewer active users, with possible limits on communications and payment processing) and $57/mo Standard (RhinoFit pricing).

What to test for a BJJ schedule

  • Can you run separate gi and no-gi calendars (or programs) without duplicate student records?
  • Do capacity caps and waitlists work the way your open mats need?
  • Can members book, cancel and get reminders from a phone app or portal?
  • Does attendance from the schedule feed belt and stripe eligibility? See belt rank tracking software and martial arts attendance software.
  • How fast is front-desk check-in when two classes turn over at once?

Vendor pages don't answer every BJJ-specific workflow in detail, so treat these as trial questions. Compare total cost in our martial arts software pricing by student count guide.

Which to shortlist

For a small academy watching price, Kicksite ($49/mo at 0-25 students), Martialytics ($69/mo at 0-50), Gymdesk ($75/mo with Gymdesk Payments) and RhinoFit ($0 Start Up or $57/mo Standard) publish the lowest entry prices here. Spark Membership ($199/mo after 8 weeks) publishes the most detail about gi/no-gi schedules on a dedicated BJJ page. Zen Planner starts at $99/mo and lists waitlists and capacity limits for online booking. {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}} {{aff:kicksite|Visit Kicksite}}

faq: What is Brazilian jiu jitsu class scheduling software?

It is school management software that publishes a class calendar, lets students book or cancel sessions, and usually ties attendance to memberships and belt tracking. Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk, Spark Membership, Zen Planner and RhinoFit all list class scheduling or online booking on their own pages (checked 2026-11-03).
Which BJJ software supports separate gi and no-gi schedules?

Spark Membership says it supports separate rosters, schedules and attendance for gi and no-gi programs (sparkmembership.com/uses/bjj-gym-software). For other tools, confirm multi-program calendars in a free trial.
Is there free BJJ class scheduling software?

RhinoFit lists Class & Appointment Scheduling on its $0 Start Up plan for 20 or fewer active users (rhinofit.ca/pricing); that tier may restrict communications and payment processing. Other tools on this page start from $49-$199/mo after any trial.
Do these tools include waitlists and capacity limits?

Martialytics lists capacity optimisation on Bookings & Events. Zen Planner lists waitlists, capacity limits and automatic reminders. Confirm waitlist behavior for Kicksite, Gymdesk, Spark and RhinoFit during a trial; not every vendor spells it out on the pricing page.
